DI_perk_toggle_blood_legacy_1 = {
    scope = character

    effect = {
        # free-edit mode: top up renown so the grant can never fail
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode }
            add_dynasty_prestige = 2750
        }
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1 }
                remove_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1
            }
            else = {
                add_dynasty_perk = blood_legacy_1
            }
        }
    }
}

DI_perk_toggle_ce1_legitimacy_legacy_5 = {
    scope = character

    effect = {
        # free-edit mode: top up renown so the grant can never fail
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = DI_legacy_editor_free_mode }
            add_dynasty_prestige = 2750
        }
        var:DI_dynasty_selected_dynasty = {
            if = {
                limit = { has_dynasty_perk = ce1_legitimacy_legacy_5 }

            }
